comment: SIMULATED. Cohort B. A NEW model-played guide (sonnet) with a library of Cohort A's 2 technique records tutors 6 NEW blind learner subagents in DIFFERENT subjects (archery, rowing, rocket). Guide retrieved a technique by stuck_signature and re-rendered its content-free core into each learner's subject+language. reuse_direction computed deterministically from technique origin_language vs learner language. Transcripts trimmed.

transcript.text: Equal and opposite forces cancel, no net force, the arrow shouldn't launch.
Be precise about ownership. The string pulls your fingers: which body does that act on? Your fingers pull the string: which body? Name each owner, then: same object or two different objects?
String->fingers acts on me; fingers->string acts on the string. Different objects. The arrow launches because the string has a net force on it?

List only the forces in the arrow's own account (string pushes arrow forward, gravity, drag); if net isn't zero it accelerates. The equal-and-opposite partner (arrow pulling string back) lives in the string's account, invisible to the arrow's ledger.
The arrow only feels string push, gravity, drag — net not zero, so it accelerates. The arrow pulling the string back is the string's problem. Third-law pairs live in separate accounts.
Oar pushes water back, water pushes oar forward equally — cancel, boat can't move forward.

Open two ledgers, 'water' and 'oar-and-boat'. Oar's force on water goes only in water's ledger; water's force on oar only in oar-and-boat's. To see if the boat moves, which ledger do you open, and does anything from water's ledger appear there?
Only the oar-and-boat ledger matters; water's push on the oar is in it, nothing crosses. But it still feels like they should cancel — where does equal-and-opposite show up?

The partner shows up when you open the water's ledger: water pushes oar forward (your ledger), oar pushes water backward (water's ledger) — same size, opposite, different owners, never share a ledger to cancel. The boat moves because your ledger's net isn't zero.

Third-law pairs always live in separate ledgers because they act on different objects; the water's backward push never cancels the forward push on my oar. The boat accelerates because my oar's ledger has a real net force.
Equal and opposite means zero net, so it should just sit there.
Take each force one at a time. Rocket pushes exhaust down — which object is that acting on? Exhaust pushes rocket up — which object? Name each owner: same object or different?
Push on exhaust belongs to exhaust, push on rocket belongs to rocket — different objects, can't add to zero. The rocket only feels the one upward force, right?

Yes — the rocket's ledger has exactly one third-law entry: exhaust pushing it up. The opposite partner is filed in the exhaust's ledger, which you closed when you chose 'rocket'. One owner, one ledger, one net force.
I was mixing entries from two ledgers. The rocket's ledger only has exhaust pushing it up, no partner in the same ledger, so it's genuinely unbalanced — that's why it accelerates.
Gaya padha lan ngelawan cancel, resultan nol, perahu ora isa maju.

Gawe akun piyambak: akun 'banyu' lan akun 'dayung lan perahu'. Gaya dayung marang banyu mung mlebu akun banyu; gaya banyu marang dayung mung mlebu akun dayung-lan-perahu. Nek arep ngerti perahu maju, akun sapa diwoco, apa gaya saka akun banyu mlebu kono?
Mung gaya banyu mendorong dayung sing mlebu akun perahu+dayung; gaya dayung marang banyu ora mlebu. Tapi isih bingung apa cukup nggawe perahu maju.
Gaya banyu ing akun perahu+dayung mung siji; nek luwih gedhe tinimbang gesekan, ana resultan, perahu maju. Pasangane 'padha lan ngelawan' ana ing akune banyu, dudu akune perahu, mula ora menehi nol.
Gaya banyu ing akun perahu+dayung mung siji; nek luwih gedhe tinimbang gesekan ana resultan, perahu maju. Pasangan Newton katelu ana ing akun banyu, ora bisa cancel ing akun perahu. Saiki mudeng.
Padha lan ngelawan entek dadi nol, roket kudune meneng.
Deloken siji-sijine gaya: roket nyemprot gas mudhun — tumiba marang sapa, roket apa gase? Gas ndorong roket munggah — tumiba marang sapa? Apa sing duwe loro-lorone iku barang padha apa beda?
Gaya roket tumiba gas, gaya gas tumiba roket — beda barang. Tapi isih bingung yen beda barang kok diarani padha lan ngelawan?
'Padha lan ngelawan' tegese ukuran padha arah ngelawan — nanging saben gaya mapan ing akune pemilik sing beda; katon ngelawan, nanging beda akun, ora tau ketemu ing siji papan kanggo dibatalake.

Mereka equal and opposite tapi nggak pernah ketemu di tempat sama — satu di roket, satu di gas buang, ora bisa cancel. Kesalahanku membayangkan keduanya di benda yang sama, padahal masing-masing milik benda beda. Saiki mudheng temenan.
Padha persis, mesthi salah siji menang; nek padha ora ana sing menang, panah ora isa mlesat.

Gawe akun piyambak: akun 'tali gendewa' lan akun 'driji'. Gaya tali marang driji mung mlebu akun driji; gaya driji marang tali mung mlebu akun tali. Nek arep ngerti sing kedadeyan karo driji, akun sapa diwoco, apa gaya saka akun tali mlebu kono?
Akun driji mung ngemu gaya saka tali, dadi ora balanced, ana gaya net. Isih bingung energi saka ngendi — apa gendewa nyimpen energi?

Energi asale saka gendewa (potensial elastis -> kinetik panah) — urusan kapisah saka Newton katelu. Akune panahmu mung perlu: tali ndorong panah, gaya net ana, panah mlaku; pasangan Newton katelu mapan ing tali.
Energi urusan beda karo Newton katelu — aku nyampur-nyampur. Sing penting: tali dorong panah, ana gaya net, panah mlaku; Newton katelu mapan ing tali, dudu panah. Saiki mudheng tenan.
